resolution.note: app-token test: fetch dropped twice then 201 returns token; 401 fails after one call; persistent drop gives up after 4 calls

title: App token mint survives a transient fetch failure
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-16: `krn pr ship` exited 70 three times in one hour ("github-app-token: GitHub refused the installation token (fetch failed)") for #1164, #1165 and #1166 while `krn doctor --unattended` minted a token minutes later; the host load average was near 30.
Outcome: src/ci/app-token.ts retries a network-level fetch failure (no HTTP status) up to 3 times with backoff before exit 70, and reuses a cached token that is still valid; an HTTP 401/403/404 still fails at once.
Why: one transient network blip kills a ship that already waited through CI, and the lane re-ships by hand.
Proof: an app-token test whose fake fetch throws TypeError("fetch failed") twice then answers 201 returns the token; one that answers 401 fails after one call.
Files: src/ci/app-token.ts, test/ci/app-token.test.ts
